_note: One entry per provider and model. Anthropic (Claude) is the only live provider (ADR 0105). Limits are the local safety caps the client enforces (the provider publishes its own, per account tier): raise them from the Anthropic console for the plan in use. verified is true only when the numbers were read from an official page or observed in the provider response headers for this account.

anthropic._note: The only selectable provider. Which model a pass uses is chosen in STEP_MODELS in src/profiles.ts; LLM_MODEL overrides it for every pass. Current Claude models take no temperature, top_p, top_k or assistant prefill; the adapter sends none.

claude-haiku-5-5.note: rpm and tpm observed in the response headers on 2026-11-11 (1000 and 580000); rpd 5000 is a local safety cap.

claude-sonnet-5-5.note: limits are local safety caps, not read from the Anthropic console; replace them with the account limits.

minimax/minimax-m3.1-flash:free.note: Free model (zero price on https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models, 2026-10-20; 1,000,000 token context; supports response_format). Limits from https://openrouter.ai/docs/api-reference/limits: free models 20 RPM, 50 RPD without credits. OpenRouter publishes no token limit: tpm is a local safety cap. It is a reasoning model: the 9 requests of 2026-10-20 used about 560 reasoning tokens each (ledger), so expectedReasoningTokens leaves room for longer answers. maxOutputTokens is the shared budget for reasoning and answer (OpenRouter: reasoning tokens count against max_tokens); with 8192 two planner calls spent all of it reasoning and returned nothing (ledger 2026-10-20: 8192 reasoning, 0 output), so it is 32768 (the model allows 524288). Reasoning per call has been 2300 to 8200+ tokens.
